children: UK floor coverings distributor's H1 2026 revenue rose 15.4% yr/yr to £89.9 mln
Adjusted pretax profit for H1 2026 rose 79.5% to £1.32 mln
Company raised £32.5 mln in equity to fund expansion and logistics investments
Likewise Group expects FY26 underlying profit before tax of at least £5.0 mln
Company expects to reach £200 mln sales revenue in 2026 based on current performance
Likewise targets £300 mln revenue in the longer term, supported by recent logistics investments
LOGISTICS INVESTMENT - Co said expanded logistics infrastructure, including new distribution hubs and increased cutting capacity, supported sales growth and improved supply chain management
PRODUCT AND SALES INITIATIVES - Co attributed revenue growth and margin improvement to product development, supplier initiatives and expanded sales force
COST PRESSURES MITIGATED - Co said it faced higher fuel and raw material costs due to Middle East conflict but absorbed impacts through pricing and operational measures
